title: Add key on Email Message Attachment Data to speed up email deletion
summary: A database key is added on the Data field of Email Message Attachment table to significantly improve performance when deleting emails, particularly during email storage cleanup operations.
key_points: Adds an index on the Data media field to avoid full table scans during attachment deletion
Directly improves email deletion performance for large tenants
Uses the same approach as the existing Document Attachment table key
Addresses performance bottleneck in Payables Agent email cleanup
